name: E2E Cost Analyst
description: Analyzes token usage and costs with structured output for E2E testing
userPromptText:
Analyze the following token usage events. Calculate the total tokens and cost for this batch, and identify the single most expensive operation. Your output must be a single, valid JSON object.

Events:
<%= JSON.stringify(it.events, null, 2) %>

structuredOutput.schemaStr: z.object({ totalInputTokens: z.number(), totalOutputTokens: z.number(), totalCost: z.number(), mostExpensiveCall: z.object({ phaseId: z.string(), cost: z.number() }) })
